name: Portland Bottling Company
old_description: For the most trusted, safest and highest quality ready-to-drink beverages in the industry, Portland Bottling Company is ready to deliver.
about:
Portland Bottling Company, founded in 1924, operates from Clackamas, Oregon, in the Portland metropolitan area. For nearly a century it has served as a fixture of the Pacific Northwest beverage industry, running multiple production, storage, and repacking facilities totaling roughly 500,000 square feet. The company is privately held; no specific ownership designation such as family- or veteran-owned is stated in public sources.

The company specializes in contract packing of ready-to-drink beverages in aluminum cans. Its capabilities cover filling, cartoning, secondary packaging, and warehousing. The canning line runs at up to 1,450 cans per minute and handles can sizes from 8.4 oz to 16 oz, with options for cold fill, tunnel pasteurization, liquid nitrogen dosing, reverse‑osmosis water treatment, and both liquid and granulated sweeteners. Cartoning equipment produces 4‑, 6‑, 8‑, 10‑, 12‑, and 24‑pack configurations, plus variety packs and registered film shrink wrap. On‑site and off‑site warehousing with 24/7 security supports distribution.

Portland Bottling works with leading and independent beverage brands across the Pacific Northwest and nationwide, shipping throughout the western United States and Canada. Its customer base includes producers of carbonated juices and waters, energy drinks, functional beverages, organic‑certified drinks, kosher beverages, and gluten‑free products.

The company emphasizes proactive partnership, treating customers’ resources as its own and maintaining rigorous quality systems. It holds FSSC 22000 certification, adheres to HACCP, and carries organic (QAI), gluten‑free (GFCO), and kosher (OU) certifications. Inline monitoring, on‑site QA labs, and third‑party audits underpin its quality assurance, while a “people‑first” culture aims to enable solutions at every production stage.
